description: This file contains extension methods for configuring state storage and log consistency providers within the Orleans.Hosting namespace. It provides methods to add default and custom state storage log consistency providers to the silo builder, as well as internal service registration details.

classes.name: StateStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure state storage-based log consistency providers.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds the default state storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a named state storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method to register the state storage log consistency provider services into the DI container.
